channel.title: BMKG Weather Alerts
channel.description: Weather Alerts from BMKG (Indonesia Agency for Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics)

item.title: Thunderstorm This Afternoon in Sulawesi Utara
item.description: Thunderstorms and heavy rainfall are forecasted to occur starting from 10 October 2026, 14:35 WITA in parts of Sulawesi Utara especially in: DIMEMBE, MANGANITU, TABUKAN TENGAH. These conditions may lead to reduced visibility, strong winds, and localized flooding. The public is strongly advised to remain vigilant during this period, limit outdoor activities, and take all necessary precautions to ensure safety. Conditions are expected to gradually improve by 10 October 2026, 16:30 WITA.
item.author: cuaca.ekstrem@bmkg.go.id (BMKG)
